summary: Murphy USA Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of $500 million 5.875% Senior Notes due 2034 by its subsidiary Murphy Oil USA. The notes were issued under an indenture dated May 27, 2026, with Murphy USA and other guarantors, and UMB Bank as trustee. Interest is payable semi-annually, with a maturity of June 1, 2034. The issuer may redeem the notes at specified prices, including a make-whole redemption prior to June 2029. The indenture includes customary restrictive covenants that may be suspended upon achieving investment-grade ratings. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation.
